desc: The Gear Fit PURSUIT Shocker shotgun case is purpose-driven and designed so you can bring all your turkey essentials with you. The case fits shotguns up to 52" and features an integrated turkey beard and spurs tape. The front pocket has neoprene sleeves for your slate calls and customized pockets for your striker and box calls. The rear pocket has four slots for mouth calls and four choke tubes, plus room for other accessories, like gloves and a face mask. The inside of the case features a heavy-duty, dual-density foam for ultimate protection. The lining is easy to clean and the oversized zippers make it easy to open and close. The Shocker Turkey Shotgun case is lockable to keep your shotgun safe.
